summary: A responsive small-studio booking application lets visitors reserve, retrieve, and cancel persisted 30-minute consultation appointments without an account.

journeys.title: A visitor books, reloads to retrieve, and cancels an appointment

steps.expect: the consultation booking form is visible
the fixed daily slot choices are shown for the selected date
the selected 10:00 slot is highlighted and appointment details fields are enabled
the name and email fields display the entered values
a booking confirmation displays the generated reference and chosen appointment time

steps.action: return to the appointment booking screen
steps.expect: the booking screen is visible for another selection
the appointment slots for the date are shown

steps.action: attempt to choose the occupied slot
steps.expect: the 10:00 slot is visibly unavailable and cannot be confirmed
the reference and email lookup form is visible
the My booking lookup form remains visible after reload

steps.action: enter the confirmation reference and booking email
steps.expect: the lookup fields show the entered reference and email
the confirmed appointment displays its reference, date, time, and status
a cancellation confirmation with the booking reference is shown

steps.action: return to the booking screen after cancellation
steps.expect: the booking screen is visible
the fixed daily slots are shown for the selected date
the released 10:00 slot can be selected

acceptance: The browser displays a persisted booking confirmation containing reference STU-20990615-1000, date 2099-06-15, and time 10:00.
The browser shows the occupied 10:00 slot as unavailable before cancellation.
The browser displays Booking cancelled and STU-20990615-1000, then permits selection of 10:00 for that date.

journeys.title: A visitor receives booking validation feedback

steps.expect: the date picker and booking controls are visible
a future-date validation message is visible and slots cannot be selected
the available fixed slot choices are visible
the 09:00 slot is selected

steps.action: clear the required visitor detail fields
steps.expect: the name and email inputs are empty

steps.action: attempt to confirm without required details
steps.expect: required-field validation messages are visible and no booking confirmation is displayed

acceptance: The browser displays Choose a future date when a visitor selects 2020-01-01.
The browser displays Name is required and Email is required when a visitor submits blank details.

journeys.title: A visitor navigates between all app screens

steps.expect: the welcome content and navigation links are visible
the appointment booking screen is visible

steps.action: navigate to the booking retrieval screen
steps.expect: the My booking screen is visible

steps.action: navigate back to the welcome screen
steps.expect: the welcome screen is visible again

acceptance: The browser can open /, /book, and /my-booking and displays each screen's heading.

routes.name: Welcome
routes.purpose: Introduce the studio and provide navigation to booking and booking retrieval.

routes.name: Book an appointment
routes.purpose: Choose a future date and available fixed consultation slot, provide details, and confirm an appointment.

routes.name: My booking
routes.purpose: Retrieve a saved booking by reference and email and cancel a confirmed appointment.

entities.name: booking
relationships: A booking reserves one fixed consultation slot identified by bookingDate and slotTime.

auth.model: No authentication; visitors retrieve bookings using a matching reference and email.
rules: A booking is displayed only when the submitted booking reference and guest email match the same persisted booking.

operations.description: Validate and persist a confirmed appointment.

responsibilities.behavior: Reject missing guest details, invalid email format, past dates, unsupported times, and date/time slots with an existing confirmed booking; for a valid reservation generate STU-YYYYMMDD-HHMM and set status to confirmed.

operations.description: Find the persisted booking matching the submitted reference and email.
Persist cancellation of the retrieved confirmed appointment.

responsibilities.behavior: Change a retrieved confirmed booking to cancelled so its date and time no longer block a new booking.

integrations.name: none
integrations.purpose: No payment, real email delivery, external calendar, or third-party integration is required.

states.loading: Navigation remains usable while the screen renders.
states.empty: No data-driven empty state is needed because welcome content is in-code.
states.error: A visible route fallback directs visitors to available screens.
states.success: Welcome content and navigation links are displayed.

states.loading: A loading indicator is shown while confirmed bookings are checked for the selected date.
states.empty: Before date selection, the screen asks the visitor to choose a future date; if all slots are confirmed, it displays 'No slots available for this date'.
states.validation: Past dates display 'Choose a future date'; name and email are required; email must use valid email format; occupied slots display '10:00 is unavailable'.
states.error: A failed save displays 'Could not save your booking. Try again.' without a booking confirmation.
states.success: A confirmation displays 'Booking confirmed', reference, selected date, and selected time.

states.loading: A loading indicator is shown while lookup or cancellation is in progress.
states.empty: Before lookup, the reference and email form is shown; an unmatched lookup displays 'No booking found with that reference and email'.
states.validation: Reference and email are required, and email must use valid email format.
states.error: A failed lookup or cancellation displays a retry message while preserving lookup values.
states.success: A retrieved booking displays its details and a completed cancellation displays 'Booking cancelled' with its reference.

acceptance.statement: The browser displays Booking confirmed, STU-20990615-1000, 2099-06-15, and 10:00 after a valid appointment submission.
After a full page reload, the browser displays the persisted confirmed appointment when STU-20990615-1000 and alex.morgan@example.com are submitted on My booking.
The browser displays '10:00 is unavailable' when a confirmed 10:00 appointment already exists for 2099-06-15.
The browser displays Booking cancelled and STU-20990615-1000 after cancellation, then allows selection of 10:00 on 2099-06-15.
The browser displays Choose a future date for a past date and displays Name is required and Email is required for blank booking details.
The browser displays Welcome at /, Book an appointment at /book, and My booking at /my-booking.

deferred.reason: The request explicitly excludes real emails.
The request explicitly excludes external calendar integration.
Booking retrieval uses reference and matching email without login.

deferred.item: Additional consultation durations or variable schedules
deferred.reason: Only 30-minute consultations with fixed daily slots are requested.
